wavetable_oscillator.notes: OSC A/B/C local RIFF WAVE frames render with pitch, level, pan, absolute/random phase, position, unison and detune. Control-thread FFT mipmaps and cubic interpolation reduce ordinary table aliasing. A typed dual-warp subset now renders Bend/Asym/PWM/Flip, selected nonlinear shapes, and audio-rate FM/RM/AM from main oscillators, SUB or NOISE through a 2x 63-tap FIR path. Many warp IDs, phase-memory modes, advanced unison and higher oversampling remain unsupported. 2026-09-27: embedded editor tables (embeddedWTData, e.g. 'Custom') keep their tableDisplayName and are now serialized as base64 float32 frames in .zygpreset and host state (previously lost on project reload); round-trip test added. The observed numFrames field is often larger than the embedded data and its meaning is unknown; only the embedded frames are used.

sub.notes: All five observed SUB shape IDs map to typed native pulse, rounded-rectangle, saw, square and triangle waveforms; discontinuous shapes use polyBLEP correction. Enable, octave/coarse pitch, level, pan, phase and routing use the shared oscillator path. Exact Serum waveform identity, continuous-phase behavior, key/velocity zones and a real active-SUB preset render remain open.

noise.notes: Native white-noise generator and local WAV/FLAC sample-backed NOISE playback render; imported slot 3 reference decoded off the audio thread by JUCE. A private noise-only derivative of the supplied 2.0.24 preset produced nonzero REAPER realtime peaks. Stereo, pitch/one-shot/color and other Serum NOISE semantics are not implemented.

filters.notes: Filters 1 and 2 use independent ZYG trapezoidal filter state. Typed native Low/High 6/12/18/24 and Band/Notch 12/24 responses use one-pole and SVF stages. MgL6/MgL18/MgL24 use a separate nonlinear four-stage native ladder with resonance feedback and FAT saturation. These fifteen IDs cover 479 of 859 enabled filter instances in the inspected factory corpus. Raw Serum IDs remain preserved and are not read by DSP. Only Filter 1 is editable in the current UI. Other filter families, exact Serum transfer matching, and full stability/performance sweeps remain open.

routing.notes: Five source routes now split into two filter inputs using provisional native balance 0=Filter 1, 100=Filter 2. One-way Filter 1-to-2 or 2-to-1 chains and filter output Main/Direct/None render; two-way feedback uses a diagnosed Main fallback. Main and Direct remain identical in the absence of FX; FX sends, global direct level and envelope-gated routing remain unsupported. Exact Serum balance transfer needs controlled verification.

envelopes.notes: Env 1 ADSHR and three native attack/decay/release curve bends render, are tested, and Env 1 can drive supported matrix destinations. Env 2-4, tempo sync, trigger/legato modes and exact Serum curve transfer remain unsupported. 2026-09-27: kParamVoiceStealRestart maps to native Envelope.restartOnSteal (off = a stolen/mono-retriggered voice re-attacks from its current level); covered by a core render test. Serum's exact steal semantics are inferred from the parameter name and remain unverified against an oracle.

lfo.notes: Native sine LFO 1 plus imported free-running Lorenz, Rossler and random sample-and-hold types render per voice. The supplied 2.0.24 preset executes its original Lorenz LFO 1 to OSC A wavetable-position route. Tempo-synced, Path/custom, mode/direction/phase/rise/delay/smooth semantics remain preserved but unsupported.

matrix.notes: All populated imported rows remain typed and visible. Env 1, velocity, note, supported LFOs and Macro 1-8 execute for OSC A/B/C wavetable position, dual-warp depth, or Filter 1/2 cutoff. The 2.0.24 fixture verifies imported Lorenz-to-WT-position and Macro 1-to-FM-depth routes; synthetic tests cover the new sources and destinations. Env 2-4, other sources/destinations, aux, curves and slew remain preserved but unsupported. 2026-09-27: UI can now create routes to every mapped continuous control (knob/spinner/fader) by drag-and-drop or a right-click source menu over the full catalog; ZYG-only MIDI CC 0-119 source added (engine-rendered, tested). Serum amount/curve/aux scaling is still unverified (see docs/SERUM_ORACLE_HANDOFF.md).

macros.notes: Eight macro values map to normalized native controls; four are visible at once in the first editor. Macro sources 1-8 execute for OSC A/B/C wavetable position, both oscillator warp depths and Filter 1/2 cutoff destinations. Other imported macro routes remain preserved without DSP.

voice_global.notes: 2026-09-27: kParamNoteCurveApplyTuning / kParamPitchExpressionApplyTuning are typed; ZYG has no microtuning tables, so they are inert and diagnosed only when on. kParamS1Compatibility is typed and always diagnosed as not rendered (undocumented legacy behaviour).

vst3_host.notes: Installed VST3 tested in separate REAPER instance with realtime MIDI, armed monitored track, nonzero track/master peaks at 48 kHz. PipeWire default sink monitor captured C4 tone after 12 s of silence (261.47 Hz FFT peak). INIT project save/reopen and editor instantiation were verified. User-edited Serum state reload, automation and other sample rates remain unverified.

clap_host.notes: Pinned clap-juce-extensions builds CLAP. Installed CLAP was inserted in REAPER with realtime MIDI item on armed monitored track; nonzero track/master peaks measured. Real Serum preset import and project reload in CLAP are not yet validated.

native_zyg_preset.notes: v2 JSON and VST3/CLAP host state retain typed patch, matrix, FX identities, LFO/macro/clip raw state, diagnostics and opaque Serum provenance. Local assets are references and reloaded; portable path handling and UI save/reopen host validation remain incomplete.

wavetable_warp.notes: Importer reads observed kParamWarpMenu/Menu2 fields and maps a bounded native subset. Dual phase maps and dual amplitude operations each process in slot order; mixed phase/amplitude order is provisional. Audio-rate source sampling is independent of oscillator render order. The 2.0.24 fixture uses kFM_OSC with a zero-level OSC B source and macro-modulated depth. OSC/OSC2 source ordering is an inference pending oracle verification. PD, FMX/FMP, Self PD, Sync, Remap, filter-source modulation, numerous distortion IDs and 4x/8x modes remain unsupported.

dsp_note: 2026-09-26: all categories are rendered by original ZYG DSP with provisional scales; 'partial' means not verified against a Serum oracle. See docs/DSP_DECISIONS.md.
